Somnath Laxman Bengude vs State Of Maharashtra And Anr on
2 February, 2026
Gitalaxmi 16-Wp
 In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
 Criminal Appellate Jurisdiction
 Writ Petition No. 354 Of 2026
 Mr. Somnath Laxman Bengude ...Petitioner
 Versus

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The State of Maharashtra And Anr. ...Respondents
Mr. Balasaheb Deshmukh, learned Advocate for the Petitioner.
Ms. Pallavi N. Dabholkar, learned A.P.P. for the State/Respondent.
_ _  CORAM : ASHWIN D. BHOBE, J.
DATE : 2nd FEBRUARY 2026.
Heard Mr. Balasaheb Deshmukh, learned Advocate for the Petitioner.
He submits that Respondent No. 2-Complainant initially alleged the offence to have been committed by the Petitioner on 29.06.2024 at about 6:00 p.m.
He submits that thereafter by way of a supplementary statement recorded on 05.10.2025, Respondent No. 2 changed the version of the date from 29.06.2024 to "25.05.2024 at 6:00 p.m.".

2. Mr. Balasaheb Deshmukh, learned Advocate for the Petitioner submits that the Investigating Officer of the present crime had by letter dated 05.10.2024, called upon Jupiter Hospital to submit the Duty Register and bio-matric in respect of the period from 20.05.2024 to 26.05.2024, which is the period alleged to be the date of incident.

He by referring to a document dated 05.10.2024, which forms a part of the charge-sheet, submits that the Jupiter Gitalaxmi 16-WP-354-2026.doc Hospital has handed over the details, as requested by the Investigating Officer.

3. Mr. Balasaheb Deshmukh, learned Advocate for the Petitioner contends that despite the Duty Register and bio-matric being in possession of the Investigating Officer, the same do not form a part of the charge-sheet.

He by relying on the decision of the Rajiv Thapar and Others v/s. Madan Lal Kapoor1, submits that the documents i.e. Duty Register and bio-matric, are of sterling quality and therefore, the Petitioner is entitled to rely on the same in this Petition.

sentences.text: 4. Issue notice to the Respondents, returnable on 09.03.2026.
5. Ms. Pallavi Dabholkar, learned A.P.P. appears and waives service of notice on behalf of the State/Respondent.

6. Perusal of the records placed before me indicates that on 27.11.2024, the learned Judicial Magistrate First Class, 9 th Court at Pune has passed the following order (at Page No. 29 of the paper- book) :-
"Order : Issue process against the accused.

entities.text: Judicial Magistrate First Class, 9 th Court at Pune
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Issue summons accordingly under Sections 376, 376(C) & 377 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860."

7. As per clarification of offence, Section 376(C) of the IPC is an offence, which is cognizable,
non-bailable and triable by the Court of Sessions.

8. Mr. Balasaheb Deshmukh, learned Advocate for the Petitioner 1. (2013)3 SCC 330.
Gitalaxmi 16-WP-354-2026.doc states that the said proceedings are pending before the Judicial Magistrate First Class, 9th Court at Pune.

entities.text: Judicial Magistrate First Class, 9th Court at Pune
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 9. Ms. Pallavi Dabholkar, learned A.P.P. for the State/Respondent was called upon to address as to "whether the Judicial Magistrate First Class would have jurisdiction to try the said offence under Section 376(C) of the IPC?".
She submits that the offence under Section 376(C) of the IPC would be triable by the Court of Sessions and not by the Court of Judicial Magistrate First Class.

10. Considering the aforesaid fact, till the returnable date, the proceedings bearing R.C.C. No. 4991 of 2024 pending before the Judicial Magistrate First Class, 9th Court at Pune (details of which are furnished by Mr. Balasaheb Deshmukh), are stayed.

entities.text: Judicial Magistrate First Class, 9th Court at Pune
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
11. Mr. Balasaheb Deshmukh, learned Advocate for the Petitioner assures the Court that spare copy of the present Criminal Writ Petition would be furnished to the Registry within a period of 10 days from today so as to enable issuance of notice to Respondent No. 2.
 [ASHWIN D. BHOBE, J.]
 GITALAXMI KRISHNA  KRISHNA KOTAWADEKAR  KOTAWADEKAR
